title: Ever go into the woods and end up here?
content: https://preview.redd.it/wmz2q24chqwf1.png?width=1536&format=png&auto=webp&s=77e4466e5717c3b16fc267f72cfe4745090dfc70 I've been here in multiple re-occurring locations in my dreams. One of them I end up in a field and then I go to the far back left of that field through an opening and I'm here. Another one just before I get out of an old neighborhood I used to live in if I take a left just before the exit I also end up here.
